subject: geography
sourceName: WJEC Eduqas GCSE Geography B specification (from 2016)

subs: Theme 1: Changing Places — Changing Economies (urbanisation in global cities; urban and rural change in the UK; global development issues)
Theme 2: Changing Environments (coasts and coastal management; rivers and river management; climate change)
Theme 3: Environmental Challenges (ecosystems and biodiversity; ecosystem management and sustainability; conservation)
Application of knowledge and skills from Themes 1–3 to an unseen resource-based issue
